scripts.dev: concurrently -n USERS,CHAT,CHAT_WORKER,JOBS,ROADMAP,EVAL,FRONT,PROMPTFOO "npm run dev:users-service" "npm run dev:chat-service" "npm run dev:chat-worker" "npm run dev:job-service" "npm run dev:roadmap-service" "npm run dev:evaluation-service" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:promptfoo-view"
scripts.build: concurrently -n USERS,CHAT,CHAT_WORKER,JOBS,ROADMAP,EVAL,FRONT "npm run build:users-service" "npm run build:chat-service" "npm run build:chat-worker" "npm run build:job-service" "npm run build:roadmap-service" "npm run build:evaluation-service" "npm run build:frontend"
scripts.eval:promptfoo:roadmap: npm --prefix evals/promptfoo run update:roadmap && npm --prefix evals/promptfoo run eval:roadmap
scripts.langfuse:up: docker compose --env-file .env.langfuse -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.langfuse-cloud.yml up -d --force-recreate otel-collector
scripts.langfuse:stop: docker compose --env-file .env.langfuse -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.langfuse-cloud.yml stop otel-collector
